item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
**The first BuildFlow for Mac.** Your MacBook's notch becomes a small BuildFlow window.
- **A greeting** when you open the lid or unlock: "Good morning", with one line about your day. - **Your inbox**: notifications, upcoming jobs, meetings, and what's waiting on you. Press Control + Option (left side) to open BuildFlow in the notch, or hover it. - **Voice**: hold Control + Option to talk, and ask about your schedule. Nothing changes until you press Accept. - **Updates** arrive on their own from now on. You can also choose Check for Updates… in the menu bar.
